info.title: [V-CS01] Q4 vs. AL4 ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
V-CS01/001EN
Blaster Blade
Normal Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](VC):If you have four or more rear-guards, this unit gets [Critical] +1.
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the front row, and retire it.

V-CS01/002EN
CEO Amaterasu
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1], draw a card, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or bottom of your deck.
[AUTO](VC/RC):When you look at your deck due to effects during your turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. (Activates for "look", "reveal", and "search" effects. +5000 each time you look regardless of number of cards)

V-CS01/003EN
Blaster Dark
Normal Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], your opponent chooses one of his or her rear-guards, and retires it.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:If your opponent has no rear-guards, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and this unit gets drive +1 until end of turn.

V-CS01/004EN
Dragonic Overlord
Normal Unit｜ Kagero｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:When its attack hits, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & discard two cards from your hand], [Stand] this unit, and it gets drive -1 until end of turn.
[ACT](VC/RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

V-CS01/005EN
Swift Archer, FUSHIMI
Normal Unit｜ Murakumo｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](VC/RC):If you have four or more rear-guards during your turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000.
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, choose one of your units, and until end of turn, that unit can attack the back row.

V-CS01/006EN
Asura Kaiser
Normal Unit｜ Nova Grappler｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When your drive check reveals a grade 2 or greater card, [Stand] one of your rear-guards, and if the revealed card is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and that rear-guard gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

V-CS01/007EN
Gwynn the Ripper
Normal Unit｜ Dark Irregulars｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [Soul-Charge 1]. Then, if you have ten or more cards in your soul, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it.

V-CS01/008EN
Nightmare Doll, Alice
Normal Unit｜ Pale Moon｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, you may call up to one <Workeroid> from your soul to (RC), and that unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle that it attacked, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1 & put this unit into your soul], and call a non-grade 3 card from your soul to (RC).
